They are responsible for exceeding customer expectations by listening to customer needs, finding products that meet their needs, providing in depth product information about the goods they are interested in and closing the sale.

  • Black Friday Period: Friday, November 20th - Sunday, November 22nd & Friday November 27th, 2026 
  • Holiday Period: Friday, December 18th - Saturday, December 26th, 2026

  • Be knowledgeable of fitting room standards and assist when needed 
  • Act as cashier when required by following cashier protocol 
  • Process shipment and ensure all merchandise is represented on the floor in full
